headline: Looking for something to do this weekend? Here are the Top 5 local events for Sept. 26-27
body:
The final weekend of September brings barbecue, live music, movies, classic cars, and a rodeo to communities across the Treasure Coast.

Here are five events worth checking out Saturday and Sunday, Sept. 26-27.

## Treasure Coast International Film, Arts and Music Festival

The Treasure Coast International Film, Arts and Music Festival continues through Sunday at EPIC Theatres, 2448 S. Federal Highway in Stuart.

The four-day festival features more than 40 indie and student films from local filmmakers and creators from beyond the Treasure Coast. The festival runs through Sept. 27, giving movie fans a full weekend to catch screenings.

Admission is listed at $10.

[See festival details](https://discovermartin.com/event/treasure-coast-international-film-arts-and-music-festival/)

## PSL Bacon and BBQ Festival

Come hungry to the MIDFLORIDA Event Center this weekend for the Port St. Lucie Bacon and BBQ Festival.

The festival brings barbecue and bacon-focused food to the event center at 9221 SE Event Center Place. The event listing advertises the festival for Sept. 26 and 27, with Saturday hours listed from 10 a.m. to 5 p.m.

Admission is free.

[See event details](https://www.midfloridaeventcenter.com/List-of-Events)

## Downtown Stuart Car & Bike Show

Classic cars, trucks and motorcycles will take over the Stuart City Hall and Annex parking lots Saturday morning for the Downtown Stuart Car & Bike Show.

The free event begins at 9 a.m. Sept. 26 at 121 SW Flagler Ave. in downtown Stuart. The City of Stuart's event description highlights a collection of vehicles representing automotive history.

[See event details](https://www.stuartfl.gov/calendar.aspx?EID=6191)

## South Florida Soul Rodeo

Rodeo action and live music come together Saturday evening at the St. Lucie County Fairgrounds in Fort Pierce.

The South Florida Soul Rodeo runs from 5 to 10 p.m. Sept. 26 at 15601 Midway Road. The event combines rodeo action with live music, food and family entertainment.

[See event details](https://visitstlucie.com/event/south-florida-soul-rodeo/)

## Jimmy Buffett tribute and '70s dance party

Sunday afternoon brings island music and a '70s dance party to Summer Crush Vineyard & Winery in Fort Pierce.

Timmy Bluffett & The Hurricanes will perform a Jimmy Buffett tribute featuring Buffett favorites, songs he was known for covering and a set of dance music. The show runs from 1 to 4 p.m. Sept. 27 at 4200 Johnston Road.

Admission is listed at $13.50.

[See event details](https://visitstlucie.com/event/a-trop-rockin-jimmy-buffett-tribute-70s-dance-party/)

Event schedules can change. Check with organizers before heading out.
teaser: Barbecue, a film festival, rodeo action, classic cars and a Jimmy Buffett tribute are among the top things happening across the Treasure Coast this weekend.
